proof_body:
by
  intro K _ V _ _ ι _ b c d h
  have hli := Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp b.linearIndependent (fun i => c i - d i) (by
    simp only [sub_smul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, h, sub_self])
  funext i
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hli i)
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] (b : Module.Basis ι K V) (c d : ι → K), ∑ i, c i • b i = ∑ i, d i • b i → c = d
